name: Guarding Secrets
label: Quest
description: Guarding Secrets: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You are unsure of the significance of the necklace that fell from the neck of the recently-slain wildkin. It glows brightly, slowly fading in and out.
Trull Failbane might be able to tell you more, since his knowledge of the wildkin seems extensive. Perhaps you should ask him about it.
